Subject: Fwd: Pilot economics + onboarding incentive — approval request

Priyom — forwarding the request from Aurora. Summary and ask below:

Summary:
- Account: AuroraAnalytics (data analytics / platform)
- Current pilot: 3 seats, light production traffic; projected steady-state monthly usage ~ $9k/month if they convert
- Ask: 30-day extension + $3,000 one-time credit + 10% discount for first 3 months
- Time pressure: procurement wants decision this week or they will evaluate alternate vendors

Why do this?
- Upside: conversion probability appears high; 9k/month run-rate implies $108k ARR if converted, plus potential expansion into other business units
- Cost: $3k one-time credit + ~10% discount on first 3 months (~$2.7k if they hit projected run-rate) — total near $5.7k TCV impact vs upside revenue

Recommendation / ask:
- Approve one-off credits of $3,000 and a 10% discount on invoiced usage for the first 3 months upon conversion. Condition the credit on reaching a minimal integration milestone (successfully routed sample traffic in production).
- Authorize AE to sign off and record credits as a one-off sales concession (deal HS-2026-4721).

If you want, I can draft the approval note for exec sign-off and copy Finance for the accounting entry. Would love a quick thumbs up or any constraints.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Marissa / Neha — thanks for the summary. I support approving the ask with the following guardrails:
1) Credit is capped at $3,000 and should be applied only after Aurora completes the integration milestone you outlined.
2) 10% discount limited to the first 3 invoiced months post-conversion; discount cannot stack with any other promotional credits.
3) AE to record concession in HubSpot (deal HS-2026-4721) with line-item "onboarding credit" and notify Finance for the credit memo.

If Finance signs off on accounting treatment, I authorize the concession. Please include a short clause in the SOW that the credit is one-time and non-recurring.
